categories.label: District points
categories.hint: Enter one value per district (2+ adjacent same-colour buildings): 1st = all resources in district, 2nd = your own resources there.

tiebreakers.description: No overall tiebreaker stated in the rulebook (only for ranking within a district: tallest building, then highest number on it).

notes: family: area-majority. District ranking tiebreak: tallest building of the tied players in the district, then highest tile number. Lone owner of all resources in a district scores both 1st and 2nd (2 per resource). Game ends when tile supply is exhausted the second time or a player places all resources (25/20/18/16 for 2/3/4/5); finish the round. Solitaire vs 'Hal' not modelled. No overall tie rule found, so sharedVictoryOnTie=false is an assumption.
